ValidationRule.description: Prevents changing the Quote Owner for Sales Director across all stages. Also prevents the current record owner from reassigning owners
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT(ISNEW()), ISCHANGED(OwnerId), $Profile.Name <> "System Administrator", OR( $Permission.Restrict_Quote_Owner_Change, PRIORVALUE(OwnerId) = $User.Id ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: You do not have permission to change the Quote Owner. Please contact Revenue Operation Team or Salesforce Administrator if this needs to be updated.
